note: Agent registry and voting weights for the Watchdog prediction swarm.
WEIGHTS ARE NOT HAND-TUNED. Every non-zero weight below is TPR minus FPR
from a recorded qualification run. If a weight needs changing, re-run
scripts/swarm_qualification.py --json and regenerate this file. Editing a
weight by hand to make an outcome look better is the failure this file
exists to prevent.
An agent that is not QUALIFIED carries weight 0.0, never a small weight.
A broken agent that votes is worse than one that abstains: it injects
noise into every decision it touches while looking like participation.

open_issue: idle_floor_w is the COLD idle floor. On 2026-09-19 this detector
reported 44.5W and 48.1W above floor while nvidia-smi read 78.98W
five consecutive times, on genuinely idle hardware. The context-alive
state draws ~126W at 0% utilization, which is ~47W above the cold
floor and is this detector's exact firing condition.
Run swarm_qualification.py: if fpr_ctx_alive far exceeds fpr_cold_idle,
the floor is misconfigured and the fix is the floor, not the threshold.

note: The agent works. It is starved, not broken: 68% TPR on randomized
trials, and its own code refuses to proceed without a real CEI value
rather than guessing one.
cei_flops_per_joule cannot be derived from passive nvidia-smi under
any field name. intelligence/cei_benchmark.py exists to produce it
(timed matmul, known FLOP count, real power sampling) and has never
been run on hardware.
THIS IS THE HIGHEST-VALUE FIX IN THE SWARM: one pod session turns a
silent agent into a working one at 68% TPR.
Two independent reasons, either sufficient on its own.
1. STARVED. One of its four weighted signals reads
row['memory_access_timing_ms'], which nothing in agent/telemetry.py
collects and which nvidia-smi does not expose. It does not crash:
the missing signal safely computes to zero, which is worse, because
the agent keeps voting with a permanently dead input.
2. BELOW BAR. 24.5% TPR is its validated figure WITH that signal
present. Real-world performance is necessarily lower.
In a weighted-consensus system a 24.5% agent with a zeroed input does
not merely fail to help. It votes on every incident it sees.
To reactivate: source memory_access_timing_ms (it would need a timing
probe, not a telemetry field), requalify at the same bar as the
others, and regenerate this file from the qualification run.
Until then it stays out of the pool and out of the weights.
